purpose: Teach: クリティカル/全会/総局/複写/扶桑社/スポークスマン/図版/中味

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: クリティカルな判断は経営陣に委ねましょう
lines.en: Let's leave the critical decisions to management.
lines.style: Measured and professional. Clear directive tone. Slight pause after "Let's" — this is a proposal, not a demand. Confident but collaborative. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。全会一致を目指して根回しをします
lines.en: Understood. I'll lay the groundwork to build consensus.
lines.style: Prompt, affirming response. Light emphasis on 「全会一致」 equivalent — showing he grasps the strategy. Respectful but not deferential. Warm undertone of being on the same page.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外総局との会議を設定しましょう
lines.en: Set up a meeting with the overseas division.
lines.style: Direct, clear instruction. Slight forward lean in the delivery. Efficient tone — no extra words. The kind of ask that expects a straightforward 「Yes」.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。契約書の複写を社内で管理します
lines.en: Understood. I'll keep the contract copies under internal control.
lines.style: Confirmatory, detail-oriented. Quick acknowledgment followed by the specific commitment. Shows he's tracking the implications. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 扶桑社のジャーナルに広告を出しましょう
lines.en: Let's place an advertisement in Fusosha's journal.
lines.style: Directive, strategic. Same measured tone as the first line. Slight pause at the opening — thinking aloud but confident. Expecting agreement and action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。スポークスマンの研修を計画しております
lines.en: Understood. I'm arranging training for the spokesperson.
lines.style: Attentive and proactive. Slight emphasis on "I'm arranging" — showing initiative beyond just receiving the order. Warm professionalism. Ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料の図版を更新しましょう
lines.en: Let's update the graphics in the materials.
lines.style: Another directive in the pattern. Crisp, efficient. Same collaborative-but-authoritative register as previous directives. Brief, expectant of quick execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提案書の中味を再構成します
lines.en: Understood. I'll restructure the proposal content.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly warmer than previous responses — acknowledges this closes the list. Solid, assured tone. Ready to deliver. Eye contact steady.
